correctness.rationale: The original source RESULT.md incorrectly claimed prod_j(1+|x_j|^2)>= (1+average |x_j|^2)^n, the reverse of AM-GM, so the original proof cannot pass unmodified. The supplied full replacement RESULT.md repairs this with correct inequalities in probabilities r_j: prod(1-r_j)<=(1-u)^n; the D_{n,1} overlap is at most n u(1-u)^{n-1} by triangle, Cauchy and Maclaurin. Witness expectation <= (s+nq t)/(q^n(1+t)^n) has unique maximum=1 at t=p/q; equality forces all r_j=p and phases equal. Strict log-Jensen and weighted AM-GM then establish global relative-entropy optimality. Any optimizer saturates the witness, hence is a common-phase mixture. Equality in log-Jensen at D0 annihilates phase Fourier moments m=1..n, making the density matrix exactly the phase twirl. Rank n+1 and roots-of-unity quadrature prove exact product length. All real n,s domain conditions and endpoint exclusions explicitly handled.
residual_risks: The initial source proof had a reversed AM-GM inequality; PASS applies ONLY to the fully supplied repaired RESULT.md.

originality.rationale: The optimal relative-entropy value and existence of a symmetric phase-twirled optimizer are established by Wei 2008; its overlap bounds supply the Maclaurin inequality. The corrected claim adds equality rigidity, uniqueness for a rank-two edge state and exact optimal finite pure-product length. Friedland-Gour full-rank uniqueness theorem is inapplicable because rho has rank two in dimension 2^n, and no checked Resultary item proves same rank-deficient conclusion.
